notes.title: Demo patch #20
notes.content:
[u][b]CHANGELOG[/b][/u]

🔧 Fixes/QoL:
[list]
[*] Mouse temporarily disabled in the game. People were experiencing crashes when using the mouse to navigate the UI, so I've removed it until a proper solution is found.
[*] Pressing Shift or Tab in the menu no longer unpauses the game.
[*] Moldcasters can no longer detect you from anywhere on the map, but they gain 'telepathy' once you enter their grotto.
[/list]

⚖️Rebalanced fall damage:
[list]
[*] Added an in-game tip to alert players about the existence of fall damage.
[*] Fall damage now scales with height: you take 1 point of damage per tile (1 tile = 1 depth) beyond the safe fall distance.
[*] The default safe fall distance is 10 tiles, so:
  Falling 11 tiles = 1 damage
  Falling 12 tiles = 2 damage
  Falling 13 tiles = 3 damage, and so on.
[*] Elven Boots double the safe fall distance (from 10 tiles to 20). They no longer reduce fall damage to a fixed 1 point. So, with Elven Boots:
  Falling 11 tiles = 0 damage
  Falling 12 tiles = 0 damage
  Falling 13 tiles = 0 damage
  ...
  Falling 21 tiles = 1 damage
  Falling 22 tiles = 2 damage
  Falling 23 tiles = 3 damage, and so on.
[*] Chainmail now absorbs fall damage, using up one charge per point of damage. For example:
  If you fall 14 tiles, you'd normally take 4 damage.
  If you're wearing the Chainmail with 3 charges, it will absorb 3 of those points, and you'll only take 1 point of actual damage to your health.
[/list]

notes.title: New content update! (patch #16)
notes.content:
More content for you, here we go:

🔧Fixes/QoL:
- Fixed a potential crash when starting the manual melee attack animation mid-air and landing on top of an enemy before it finished.
- Fixed a potential soft lock on some systems during the loading screen for a new run.

⚖️Balance:
- Increased Jadestone sell price to 12 (from 10).
- Player can no longer be hurt after the teleport animation begins when using the Recall Scroll.

🏆New Relics System:
- Added a new NPC to the Throne Room: the Royal Prospector, who gives clues about the depth of a relic for the next run.
- For a relic to count as "found," the player must complete a run while carrying it. Finding it and then losing the run does not count.
- Introduced 10 unique relics to discover as part of the game's meta-progression system.
- Added a new related Steam achievement: "Trinkets and Baubles."

Have fun!

[*] The Shroom Grotto can no longer spawn directly below the Goblin Camp.
[/list]

notes.title: Balance update #14
notes.content:
As expected, the last major content update disrupted some of the game's balance. This patch addresses the most significant issues.
Here’s the full changelog:

🔧Fixes/QoL:
- Fixed potential soft locks when pausing the game in the Throne Room while trying to start a new run or perform other special actions.
- Fixed UI not displaying correctly after Tribute 20 (you madman, how did you even get to Tribute 20!?)
- Vaults can no longer block the vertical path to the Adamant Core.
- Fixed the Adamant Core light not rendering correctly.
- Various UI and menu fixes in preparation for future translations to non-Latin languages.
- Support for Nintendo controllers (Switch/Pro).

💰Economy balance:
- Crossbow price increased to 1500 (from 1000).
- Dynamite price increased to 250 (from 200).
- Explosive bolts price increased to 100 (from 60).
- Dwarven Ale base price reduced to 500 (from 1000).
- Pickaxe +1 upgrade price reduced to 100 (from 150).
- Backpack upgrades price increased to 300 > 600 > 1200 (from 200 > 500 > 1000).

👑King balance:
- The King now rewards a Magic Item every two Tributes (at tiers 3, 5, 7, 9, etc.) instead of after every Tribute.
- The King's Patience amount has been reduced (again) after the first two Tributes.
- After completing a Tribute, a 10-second Grace Period now begins during which the King's Patience will not decrease.
- The Grace Period is doubled (to 20 seconds) at the start of a run and for the second Tribute.

⛏️Item balance:
- Fall damage is now lethal unless you're wearing Elven Boots.
- Elven Boots no longer negate fall damage entirely - you now take 1 HP of damage.
- Reduced the Elven Boots' fall distance bonus to 1.5x (from 2.0x).
- Taking fall damage while wearing Elven Boots now completely breaks your Chainmail.
- Chainmail no longer protects against magic (Moldcasters now damage your health directly).
- Recall Scroll cooldown increased to 240 seconds (from 120 seconds).
- Stone Ring now divides the carry penalty by 3 (was 2). With a full backpack, this means you now move at only -8% speed penalty instead of -25% without the ring.

Also, in case you missed it, here’s the last devlog detailing the previous changes:
[previewyoutube=wtbt5O3hdEA;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers!

notes.title: Big content update!
notes.content:
Howdy all!
As you may've noticed, I took a break from regular patches to work on new content for the game. Thanks so much for your patience and awesome feedback!

I know the game still has some crashes to be fixed, but I’ll tackle everything I can as time permits.

Here’s the complete changelog for this patch:

🔧 Fixes/QoL
- Fixed an occasional crash when mining certain types of terrain.
- Fixed an occasional crash when killing a goblin.
- Fixed an occasional crash when returning to the Throne Room after a run.
- Fixed a freeze when starting a new run while mid-air.
- Fixed tooltips occasionally disappearing too quickly.
- Cooldown timer for active items is now more accurate.
- Enemy corpses no longer collide with crossbow bolts.
- Goblins can now stab to the left with their daggers.

👑 Rebalanced King's Patience & Tribute System
- Remaining Patience from a completed Tribute now carries over to the next one.
- Tribute costs have been increased across all tiers.
- King's Patience has been reduced in all tiers after the first one.

🍺 New Beer-Based Health System
- Health is now represented by beer pips at the top-left of the screen.
- When you take damage, you lose 1 beer pip.
- If you take damage with 0 pips, you die.
- Beer pips can be restored by purchasing Dwarven Ale at the Miners' Guild Shop.
- When buying Dwarven Ale:
	1. If you're at full health, your max health increases by 1 (up to a maximum of 5 pips).
	2. If you're missing health, you heal 1 pip, but your max health does not increase.
	3. No matter if you heal or boost your max health, the price of the next mug of Dwarven Ale will increase by 0.5x its base cost (base price: 1000 dwarfcoins).
- The Chainmail item was completely revamped to better fit the new health system:
	1. It now has 3 durability (when receiving damage, it consumes 1 durability instead of loosing health).
	2. It no longer protects from fall damage.

🍄 New area: Shroom Grotto
- The mine now spawns a Shroom Grotto around one of the Core Sigils.
- New enemy: Shroomkin - Disguises itself as a regular mushroom and releases toxic spores when approached.
- New enemy: Moldcaster - A ranged shroomkin that hurls mold bolts from afar.

🏆 New Steam Achievements (will be will be enabled in the full game)
- "Treasure Hoarder".
- "Untouched".
- "Iron Liver".
- "Spore no more".


Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo patch #4
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Thanks again for all the awesome feedback! I'm still doing my best to fix issues and add the essential QoL features you’ve been asking for.

There are new mechanics and content on the roadmap, but for now, the focus is on making the game more stable and bug-free.

Anyway, here are the changes for this patch:

[list]
[*] Fixed more compatibility issues with Windows 10 that caused crashes and rendering bugs on some systems.
[*] Added a timer to indicate how much time is left on the Scroll of Recall cooldown.
[*] The Core now gets fully revealed when you find it.
[*] Fixed some cases where you received the wrong item when purchasing from the Miners' Guild Shop.
[*] Fixed an exploit where holding the manual attack button while mining downward increased mining speed and didn't reset Frenzy status.
[*] Increased Frenzy duration to 2 seconds (up from 1.75 seconds).
[*] Frenzy no longer cancels when falling short distances (but still cancels when jumping).
[*] Magic Mushrooms now increase Frenzy duration to 3 seconds (in addition to raising max charges to 6).
[/list]

Cheers!

[/list]


Cheers!
